# find pixels that are local minima and darker
cands=[]
for y in range(80, 400, 1):
    for x in range(80, 560, 1):
        v = pix[x,y]
        if v > 70 or v < 15:
            continue
        # check local min
        if v > pix[x-1,y] or v > pix[x+1,y] or v > pix[x,y-1] or v > pix[x,y+1]:
            continue
        # ring
        ring=[]
        for dy in range(-6,7,2):
            for dx in range(-6,7,2):
                if abs(dx)+abs(dy)<5: continue
                ring.append(pix[x+dx,y+dy])
        if not ring: continue
        avg=sum(ring)/len(ring)
        if avg-v > 25 and avg > 90:
            cands.append((avg-v, x, y, v, avg))
cands.sort(reverse=True)
used=[]
clusters=[]

    x,y=item[1],item[2]
